rows.proof: `Fiscal Year 2011 Abstract of Assessments`, the third table on `BOARD OF ASSESSORS`, PDF page 10 of the FY2012 annual town report, printed folio 7. Read off the page's own 518 dpi bitmap; no recognition. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE (rule 13b.4), is `Property Class Code/Description` | `Accts` | `Class Valuation` | `Avg.Value`. WHAT PROVES IT: the twelve classes foot to the printed TOTALS `Class Valuation` of 1,120,966,561 EXACTLY, no tolerance -- and that is the same figure the table ABOVE it reaches by a different route, from five property classes instead of twelve. THE ACCTS TOTAL IS THE TOWN'S OWN DISAGREEMENT AND IS ATTESTED, NOT MENDED: the twelve printed counts sum to 5,351 and the TOTALS row prints 5,185. Both are real figures in this report -- the `Valuation and Tax History` on the SAME PAGE prints 5,351 accounts for FY2012 and 5,185 for FY2011 -- so the row reads as FY2011's account count printed under FY2012's class detail, under a heading that says `Fiscal Year 2011`. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: which of the two the table is meant to be. The class valuations are FY2012's total to the dollar, which argues the DETAIL is FY2012; the heading and the accts total argue FY2011. Nothing on the page settles it and nothing here chooses -- a residual equal to one plausible misread is exactly the digit that must not be picked (rule 14), and 166 is not that: every count was re-read at full scale off a crop of this block. `Avg.Value` is recorded as printed and is NOT checked: the page divides inconsistently -- 64,741,400 / 435 = 148,831.9 prints as 148,831 and 23,951,500 / 86 = 278,505.8 prints as 278,506 -- so rounding is not a rule this table follows and asserting one would be our claim.

rows.proof: `BOARD OF ASSESSORS`, PDF page 10 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folio 7. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages, tested per page -- so the page was read off its OWN stored bitmap rather than a re-render; no recognition was used and the OCR cache is not a starting point. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `Property Class` | `Levy Percent` | `Valuation by Class` | `Tax Rate` | `Tax Levy`. WHAT PROVES IT: the five classes foot to the printed TOTALS row in all three summable columns EXACTLY, no tolerance declared -- levy percent 100.0000, valuation 1,120,966,561 and tax levy 18,865,867.23. A fourth, independent check holds and is not needed for the verdict: the valuation at the printed rate, 1,120,966,561 x 16.83/1000 = 18,865,867.22, is the printed levy within the cent the per-thousand rate costs. ALSO IN THIS FILE as `line` rows, because neither table prints a total: the `Valuation and Tax History`, eight fiscal years, where valuation x rate / 1000 reproduces the printed tax levy within a cent in all eight and each year's printed Change(%) reproduces the step in the levy; and the `Assessor's Account for Exemptions and Abatements`, five years by five descriptions, where `-0-` is the page's explicit zero. THE HISTORY ROWS AGREE WITH A SECOND DOCUMENT: FY2015's own page 35 prints FY2012 as rate 16.83, valuation 1,120,966,561, 5,351 accounts, levy 18,865,867.23, change 4.77 -- identical, and read there off a text layer rather than a photograph. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing here checks the history, the exemptions or the new-growth figures against the town's ledger; they are what the page prints.

rows.proof: `FY 2012 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2012`, PDF page 58 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folio 55. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages, tested per page -- so it was read off the page's OWN stored bitmap; NO recognition was used and the 75 rows the recognition extract holds for this page were not consulted. THE PAGE IS BOUND UPSIDE DOWN in the PDF and was turned 180 degrees to be read. WHAT PROVES IT: the page prints a `SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS` block of NINE categories and a `GRAND TOTAL`, and the nine foot to it EXACTLY -- 28,471,842.32, no tolerance declared. That is the identity this page states about itself and it is what the verdict rests on. ALSO READ, as `line` rows and NOT summed: all 91 detail lines the page prints, under the nine section headings it prints (`TAXES & EXCISES:`, `INTEREST:`, `DEMANDS:`, `FEES:`, `DEPARTMENTAL REVENUE:`, `LICENSES/PERMITS:`, `STATE REVENUE:`, `FINES & FORFEITS:`, `EARNINGS ON INVESTMENTS:`). WHAT THE DETAIL DOES AND DOES NOT ESTABLISH -- read this before using either half. The page does NOT say which detail line belongs to which summary category, so any mapping is OURS. One mapping reproduces SEVEN of the nine categories to the cent and is recorded here as a hypothesis the arithmetic supports, not as something the page states: LICENSES AND PERMITS 197,776.50 (the 18 lines under `LICENSES/PERMITS:`), STATE REVENUE 6,330,678.71 (the 10 lines under `STATE REVENUE:`), SPECIAL ASSESSMENTS 103,741.62 (TRAILER PARKS, both MEADOW WOODS WATER BETTERMENT lines and both STREET BETTERMENT lines -- but NOT RESCUE WAGON, which is printed among them), INVESTMENT INCOME 15,388.54, TRANSFER FROM OTHER FUNDS 845,072.00, TAXES & EXCISES 20,152,412.70 (the tax, interest, demand, tax-lien-penalty, payment-in-lieu and prior-year lines, but NOT SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION) and NON RECURRING REVENUE 306,513.90 (SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION 124,411.86 + MISC. REVENUE 24,407.53 + PREMIUM SALE OF BONDS 157,023.81 + SALE OF TOWN PROPERTY/EQUIPMENT 670.70). Two constraints independently place SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION in NON RECURRING REVENUE, which is why it is recorded that way and still labelled a hypothesis. TWO CATEGORIES CANNOT BE REPRODUCED, AND THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT THE DOCUMENT, NOT ABOUT THE READING: every printed line on the page sums to 28,443,455.76 against a printed GRAND TOTAL of 28,471,842.32, SHORT BY 28,386.56 -- and under the mapping above that residue falls entirely in two categories, FINES & FORFEITS short by 25,276.56 (the page prints only PARKING FINES 2,120.25 and DOG FINES 2,550.00 against a category total of 29,946.81) and FEES short by 3,110.00. The whole page was swept for a missed row: the table ends at PARKING FINES, the right column begins at DOG FINES, and there is no row above, below or between them. Nothing here supplies the missing lines and nothing here guesses at them. See money-gaps for the registered question and the document that would settle it.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2012`, PDF pages 60-65 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 57-62. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages -- so it was read off the pages' own 518 dpi bitmaps; NO recognition was used. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is identical on all six pages: `PROGRAM NAME` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE` | `TOTAL EXPENDED` | `TOTAL ENCUMBERED` | `BALANCE TO REVENUE`. THE SHAPE: a department prints its line items and then an UNLABELLED rule-and-total row. Only the total rows carry the identity, so the line items are `kind=line` (recorded, not summed) and the department totals are `kind=fund` (summed, and identity-checked). Some departments print ONE row that is also their total row. ABSENT IS NOT ZERO: many rows print no encumbrance and no balance cell at all, and those cells are left EMPTY rather than written as 0.00 -- the page's own `$0.00` is recorded as 0.00 and is a different fact. Rows printing no balance cell are counted and named by the verifier rather than passed or failed. THE FLAG WORDS `fwd`, `srt` and `rft` print after a cell and are the page's own legend at the foot of p65: `fwd - forward from FY 2011` $207,450.46, `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer` $7,320.50, `rft - Reserve Fund Transfer` $44,393.02. A flagged carry-forward that has no label of its own is recorded as a line named for its flag. WHAT PROVES IT: the run foots to the GRAND TOTAL p65 prints in ALL FIVE COLUMNS -- $28,395,610.46 / $28,395,610.46 / $28,063,432.58 / $160,872.50 / $171,305.38 -- and every department total that prints a balance closes on the identity the table states about itself, available less expended less encumbered equals balance to revenue. No tolerance is declared anywhere in this run.
